confidence_notes: Local price indexes support the meal, cappuccino and draft beer estimates. [Wise](https://wise.com/us/cost-of-living/brazil/foz-do-iguacu) Cocktail and house wine estimates use local beer prices as a baseline, with a small sample of menus as a check. [Terramar menu](https://restaurantguru.com/Terramar-Restaurante-Foz-do-Iguacu/menu), [Terrazzo menu](https://www.terrazzofoz.com.br/cardapio/) July lodging prices are model estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized cities in western Paraná provide the lodging baseline, with an allowance for July school-holiday demand at the falls and the supply of budget rooms downtown.
